question: Estimate the customer segment for luxury wristwatches (₹50,000+) in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Annual buyers of wristwatches above ₹50,000 (Rolex, Omega, Tag Heuer, Cartier, Tissot premium, etc.)? Yes.
Both Indian retail + grey market + online? Yes (organized primarily).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: HNI + UHNI buyer count × purchase frequency.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian HNI individuals (₹5 Cr+ net worth): ~3.5 lakh (per Knight Frank Wealth Report).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Add upper-middle affluent likely to buy occasional luxury watch (₹50K-1L): ~5 lakh more.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average buyer purchases 1.2 watches/year → ~5-5.5 lakh units sold.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~4-5 lakh annual buyers; ~₹6,000-7,000 Cr market.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Indian HNI individuals (₹5 Cr+ net worth)
Active luxury watch buyers (purchased any in past year)

calculationFlow: Indian HNI individuals (₹5 Cr+ net worth): ~3.5 lakh (per Knight Frank Wealth Report).
Add upper-middle affluent likely to buy occasional luxury watch (₹50K-1L): ~5 lakh more.
Active luxury watch buyers (purchased any in past year): ~50% = ~4-4.5 lakh.
Average buyer purchases 1.2 watches/year → ~5-5.5 lakh units sold.
Round: ~4-5 lakh annual buyers; ~₹6,000-7,000 Cr market.
